cpu_policy: nice -n 10, 8 threads, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="" for every llama.cpp CPU process

exclusion.rule: DEV id; or normalized prompt / current-region / non-no-op target sha256 shared with a DEV case; or 3-line prompt-shingle containment >= 50% (>= 3 shared, boilerplate shingles ignored)

token_feeding.imatrix: Rows are detokenized with the pinned HF tokenizer (they round-trip exactly). Each row's BOS 0 and EOS 1 are written as '<s>' and '</s>' and parsed back into control tokens by llama-imatrix --parse-special. The first '<s>' is left out because llama.cpp adds BOS (add_bos_token true). Chunks hold exactly 4,096 tokens and each starts at a row's BOS, so llama-imatrix's per-chunk BOS overwrite changes nothing. Gaps are filled with a round-tripping prompt prefix of an extra TRAIN row placed first in the chunk. Rows mentioning any added-token string are skipped. --no-escape keeps backslash sequences in R code literal.
token_feeding.kld: llama-perplexity never parses control tokens, so each chunk is one window: the last 1,023 tokens of a held-out row before its EOS, ending with the gold target. Chunk 0 relies on the added BOS; later chunks begin with '<think>' (user-defined id 8, matched without special parsing), which llama-perplexity overwrites with BOS.
token_feeding.verification: llama-tokenize (same common_tokenize path; special parsing on for calibration, --no-parse-special for KLD) on the parent GGUF vocabulary reproduces both expected id streams exactly (540,672 and 65,536 tokens). In the smoke, the token stream stored in the bf16 --kl-divergence-base file also equals the slice's expected ids.

smoke.purpose: plumbing only on the CPT parent (step 11,586); quality numbers mean nothing
smoke.command: quantize_and_gate.py --hf-dir <checkpoint-11586> --name parent-11586 --source-gguf parent-11586-bf16.gguf --existing Q8_0=parent-11586-Q8_0.gguf --existing Q4_K_M-uncalibrated=parent-11586-Q4_K_M.gguf --variants Q8_0 Q4_K_M Q4_K_M-uncalibrated --panels dev75 --limit 3 --order shortest --cap 64 --imatrix-chunks 1 --kld-chunks 2 --threads 8
smoke.dev75_3_cases_cap_64: all four GGUFs: valid 0, exact 0, cap 3 (the CPT parent does not follow PRM03; failures duplicate_exact_terminal/content_after_terminal). Token identity vs bf16: Q8_0 2/3, Q4_K_M 0/3.
smoke.gate: every tier not_gate_eligible (smoke panel, 3 cases, cap 64), as designed

checks.check_training: not run: no training code changed

notes: Q4_K_M already stores ffn_down of layers 0-4 and 37-41 (and every third layer) as q6_K and attn_v as q6_K at b10453, so in the Q4_K_M+ arm only attn_k and attn_v -> q8_0 change anything.
Q8_0 ignores the imatrix in llama-quantize; the Q8_0 tier is the same file with or without one.

The gate's nofp/valid pp are over all panel cases; McNemar fails a tier only for a significant loss; the net-loss bound is Bonett-Price adjusted Wald. These are implementation choices for the user's sign-off.
Full CPU estimate at 8 threads: imatrix about 1.7 h (132 chunks), DEV250 plus DEV75 for bf16 and 7 tiers about 11 to 12 h, KLD under 1 h, quantization about 15 min.
